recommendations: Ishan Singh “I had the pleasure of supervising and working alongside Krish during his time at RBC. Krish was an outstanding contributor to the team—he was very passionate about furthering his knowledge of new technologies, and was able to thoroughly grasp React, Node.js, and Express.js in just two weeks. He demonstrated an exceptional work ethic, always challenging himself by developing creative features that made our product more impactful and accessible to users. It was incredible to see Krish self-learn and contribute to the various backend tasks in such a short period of time. For instance, he helped lead the successful implementation of data analytics into our project through tools such as Elasticsearch. Working in an agile environment, Krish also found ways to improve his work by continually obtaining feedback from our users and his fellow team members. All in all, I had a fantastic time working with Krish, and wholeheartedly recommend him as an invaluable asset to any team.”

honors_and_awards.title: Most Technically Impressive MCP Automation, HackMIT 2025
honors_and_awards.description: Won the Poke MCP Challenge (Most Technically Impressive MCP Automation) at HackMIT 2025—one of North America's largest hackathons, with 1,000+ participants. Received iPhone 17 Pros, an all-expenses-paid trip to Palo Alto, and customized North Face jackets from The Interaction Company of California. My team built Mijiji—an interface that enables you to sell anything on an online marketplace, with just a text message.

honors_and_awards.title: Best AI Smart Contract Auditor ($3,000 USD), ETHDenver 2025
honors_and_awards.description: Won award for Best AI Smart Contract Auditor ($3,000 USD), and placed Top 10 Overall in the Identity, Privacy & Security category at ETHDenver 2025—the world's largest Ethereum conference, with 900+ hackathon participants. Featured in news article published by the University of Waterloo. My team built BrokeChain—a web application that scans your GitHub repositories for critical vulnerabilities in your Solidity code, through an agentic workflow.

honors_and_awards.title: First Place (Federato Category, $3,500), 2025 CxC Data Hackathon
honors_and_awards.description: Won first place in the Federato category and third place overall ($3,500) at the 2025 CxC Data Hackathon—Canada's largest student-run data hackathon, with 300+ participants. My team built an AI-powered next action recommendation system to boost user engagement, streamline decision-making, and enhance personalized experiences with intelligent automation.

honors_and_awards.title: Best Forward Thinking Hack, McHacks 12
honors_and_awards.description: Won Best Forward Thinking Hack at McHacks 12 (470+ participants), and took home Rocketbook Fusion smart notebooks. We built Veyesor—a novel way for you to drive your vehicle, unobstructed, leveraging the power of VR.

honors_and_awards.title: Third Place Overall, Hack Western 11
honors_and_awards.description: Won Third Place Overall at Hack Western 11 (400+ participants), and took home Fujifilm Instax Mini Link 3 Smartphone Printers. We built Mark3d—revolutionizing the secondhand online marketplace, with accessible 3D modelling.

honors_and_awards.title: Top 6 Finalist, 2024 Meta Llama Toronto Hackathon
honors_and_awards.description: Placed as a Top 6 Finalist at the 2024 Meta Llama Toronto Hackathon (150+ participants). We built Polisims—a real-time data simulation system, to predict how government policies impact different industries and stakeholders.

honors_and_awards.title: First Place ($4,000), 2024 BDO Future Leaders Challenge
honors_and_awards.description: Placed first out of 219 teams at the 2024 BDO Future Leaders Business Challenge, winning a $4,000 total cash prize. Pitched a strategic technical solution for BDO to help with the setting and achievement of ESG goals in the agriculture industry.

honors_and_awards.title: Top Speaker Award, 2024 Xlerate Lazardis Annual Case Competition
honors_and_awards.description: Placed as the top speaker at the 2024 Xlerate Lazardis Annual Case Competition, hosted by the Lazardis School of Business & Economics at Wilfrid Laurier University—for demonstrating an outstanding degree of public speaking skills among 127 competitors.

honors_and_awards.title: Second Place, FBLA International Competition
honors_and_awards.description: My partner and I placed as international finalists at the FBLA National Leadership Conference (NLC) in the category of Entrepreneurship, ranking 2nd out of 1,000+ teams globally—based on our combined case study and exam scores.

honors_and_awards.title: Schulich Leader Scholarship (offered)
honors_and_awards.description: Offered Canada's largest undergraduate STEM scholarship, valued at $100,000 over four years, to pursue a bachelor's degree at McGill University studying computer science.

honors_and_awards.title: René Descartes National Scholarship (accepted)
honors_and_awards.description: One of ten national scholarship recipients—awarded with $25,000 to pursue an undergraduate degree studying computer science, under the Faculty of Mathematics at the University of Waterloo.

honors_and_awards.title: First Place, FBLA National Competition
honors_and_awards.description: My partner and I placed as the National Champions of the FBLA Canadian National Leadership Conference (CNLC) in the category of Entrepreneurship, ranking 1st out of 80 teams—based on our combined case study and exam scores. Qualified for the international competition (NLC) in Atlanta, Georgia, taking place in June 2023.

honors_and_awards.title: First Place, Y2 Pitch Competition
honors_and_awards.description: Led a group of 7 as team captain to develop a comprehensive business pitch, from scratch—over the span of only one week. Our venture (SchedulAI) was selected as first place overall, by a judge panel consisting of seasoned entrepreneurs and investors. Won a fully paid sit-down dinner with a business mentor, to obtain guidance and assist us in the further development of our startup.

honors_and_awards.title: Certificate of Distinction, 2023 Canadian Computing Competition (Senior Division)
honors_and_awards.description: Honoured with a certificate of distinction for outstanding performance in the 2023 Canadian Computing Competition — Senior Division (Top 25% of 3,400+ contestants), hosted by the University of Waterloo.

honors_and_awards.title: Top 10 Finalist, DECA Ontario Provincials (MTDM)
honors_and_awards.description: My partner and I placed as Top 10 overall finalists for a business case competition at the provincial level, out of 127 teams in the category of Marketing Management Team Decision Making (MTDM)—based on our combined case study and exam scores.

honors_and_awards.title: Top 10 Finalist, DECA York Regionals (MTDM)
honors_and_awards.description: My partner and I placed in the Top 10 overall teams for a business case competition at the regional level, in the category of Marketing Management Team Decision Making (MTDM)—with our combined case study and exam scores. We qualified for the Provincial Competition in Toronto, Ontario.

honors_and_awards.title: Top 15%, EconBowl 2022 Competition
honors_and_awards.description: My team (of four) ranked in the Top 15% of the 112 teams internationally competing at the 2022 EconBowl Competition, hosted by the Youth Economics Initiative. This was based on our performance on an exam centred around economics—covering a variety of topics including microeconomics, macroeconomics, and global trade.

honors_and_awards.title: Top 3%, 2022 Canadian Senior Mathematics Contest
honors_and_awards.description: Honoured with a certificate of distinction for outstanding performance in the 2022 Canadian Senior Mathematics Contest, hosted by the University of Waterloo. My score ranked me in the Top 3% of 13,000+ contestants (including international participants).

honors_and_awards.title: Most Creative Data Composition, Hack the North 2022 Hackathon
honors_and_awards.description: Won first place at Hack the North 2022, in the category of "Rebuilding the Internet: Most Creative Data Composition". This was at Canada's largest hackathon, with 800+ participants. Our project team built Sonr rADar—a decentralized advertising platform, leveraging the power of blockchain to give users full control of their personal data.

honors_and_awards.title: Certificate of Distinction, 2022 Hypatia Mathematics Contest
honors_and_awards.description: Honoured with a certificate of distinction for outstanding performance in the 2022 Hypatia Mathematics Contest (Top 16% of 6,700+ contestants), hosted by the University of Waterloo.

honors_and_awards.title: Fourth Place, FBLA National Competition
honors_and_awards.description: I was one of the top ten overall finalists at the FBLA Canadian National Leadership Conference (CNLC) in the category of Entrepreneurship, placing 4th out of 120 competitors—based on my combined case study and exam score.

honors_and_awards.title: Top 10 Entrepreneurship Exam & Finalist (ENT), DECA Internationals
honors_and_awards.description: Recognized for my exam score, which placed in the Top 10 of 200 competitors at the DECA International Career Development Conference (ICDC), in the category of Entrepreneurship (ENT). This conference brought together the top DECA competitors from around the world, as it is an invite-only event. The exam covered a multitude of business topics, from customer relations and emotional intelligence, to financial analysis, economics, and information management.

honors_and_awards.title: Best Local Vendor Search Engine, WinHacks 2021 Hackathon
honors_and_awards.description: Awarded for developing a project, out of 14 total teams, that best tackled the challenge prompt of creating a local vendor search engine, based on creativity, design, and execution.

honors_and_awards.title: DECA International Qualifier, Entrepreneurship (ENT)
